instruction: Transform the supplied ivory school perimeter fence into an open gate, preserving material, rail design, lighting and camera; user approved gate. Preserve original PNG.
nameRendering: Six live SVG tspan characters vertically in the left pillar panel; no generated or misspelled raster text.
cleanup: Clear only between the main gate pillars, including the complete old rail and shadow. Existing native rails extend under each opaque pillar. Reuse native asphalt along the original 1:2 diagonal. Never use the image bounding box as a cleanup mask.
assembly: Use main pillars and the two open door leaves only; retain both original campus fence wings at their native coordinates. Adapted auxiliary rails are excluded because their height/spacing differs.

pillarFaceRepair.reason: Reuse the clean stone face from the same gate artwork to replace the right auxiliary post and taller rail stubs; keep original PNG unchanged.
